University of Kashmir
NAAC Accredited Grade A++
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar 190006, Kashmir.
NOTICE
It is hereby notified for the information of all candidates who have applied for the
post of Assistant Professor, (Tenure) in the Centre for Interdisciplinary Research &
Innovations (C.I.R.I) advertised vide Advertisement Notice No. 08 of 2025 dated
24.11.2025, that the deficiency/observation list of candidates is enclosed as
Annexure–I to this notice.
All concerned candidates are directed to check their particulars viz-a-viz
deficiencies/observations indicated against his/her name and clear the same by or
before 13-05-2026 upto 4:00 p.m with documentary evidence in the office of the
Recruitment Section.
No separate communication in this regard shall be made.
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar

32. 81341 1. NET–JRF Claim (Page 9):
The candidate has claimed that she has qualified NET with JRF
on page number 9. However, it appears that this is not NET–JRF
but a research fellowship titled “UGC-BSR.” Therefore, the
entries presently treated as invalid. However, the matter may be
placed before the High-Level Screening Committee, whose
decision shall be final.
2. Experience (Pages 10–11):
The experience mentioned on pages 10–11 does not constitute
teaching experience. Hence, it is considered invalid. However, the
case may also be referred to the High-Level Screening Committee
for further consideration.
3. PDF Experience (Pages 12–13):
For the PDF experience mentioned on pages 12–13, the PDF
completion
Certificates are not attached. Offer/award letters cannot be
accepted as valid proof of completion. Additionally, the dates
mentioned appear to be incorrect.
The candidate must submit PDF completion certificates with
correct dates clearly mentioned. The certificates must also be
signed by the competent institutional authority. Signatures of
Principal Investigators or Lab Heads cannot be treated as
competent authority; the certificate must be issued and signed by
the authorized institutional authority.
4. Awards (Pages 14–18):
The awards mentioned on pages 14–18 are not valid.
